title: Maximum Number of Non-overlapping Palindrome Substrings
summary: Given a string and a positive integer k, find the maximum number of non-overlapping palindromic substrings, each at least k characters long.
statement: Given a string and a positive integer k, find the maximum number of non-overlapping palindromic substrings, each at least k characters long.
constraints: s is a nonempty lowercase string and 1 <= k <= len(s).
Choose contiguous palindromes of length at least k whose index ranges do not overlap.
Return the greatest possible number of chosen substrings.
hints: A prefix optimum either skips its last character or ends with one chosen palindrome.
Precompute palindrome intervals, then run prefix DP over non-overlapping endings.
For each end, inherit the previous best and try every qualifying palindrome [start,end), adding one to best[start].
Every optimal selection has a final interval or omits the final character; these exhaustive disjoint cases make the prefix recurrence exact.
editorial: Every optimal selection has a final interval or omits the final character; these exhaustive disjoint cases make the prefix recurrence exact.

tests.explanation: The non-overlapping palindromes aba and dbbd give the optimal count two.
No substring of length at least two is a palindrome, so the answer is zero.
